# PubSoft — AI Integration Guide

.NET 10 infrastructure building blocks for microservices. Independent `PubSoft.*`
packages, each one honest job. Read this file first; it maps the repo and the
pitfalls. API ground truth: `src/*/PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt` per package — a symbol
not in the ledger does not exist; never invent API names.

## Source map (navigate by layer)

| `src/` | Contents | Depends on |
|---|---|---|
| `core/` | pure contracts/algorithms — no ASP.NET/EF/Redis | nothing |
| `platform/` | Redis, caching, scheduling, monitoring, outbound, tokens, notifications, modularity | core |
| `data/` | EF Core contexts/providers, auditing, outbox | platform |
| `messaging/` | message/outbox/inbox infrastructure | data |
| `security/` | JWT/OAuth/authorization/cryptography/HMAC | platform |
| `host/` | ASP.NET adapters: AspNetCore middleware, Edge entry | all |
| `testing/` | `PubSoft.Testing` helpers | — |

Typical wiring: host registers `AddDbContext<AppDbContext>` (concrete type!) →
data/platform packages → `AddPubSoft*` feature extensions → middleware via
`app.UsePubSoft*()`.

## Task → package

| You need | Use |
|---|---|
| multi-tenant EF + scope filters + audit + health | `PubSoft.EntityFrameworkCore` (`PubSoftDbContext`, `AddPubSoftEfCoreHealthCheck<T>`) |
| local + IdP JWT on one API | `PubSoft.Authentication.Jwt.AspNetCore` `AddPubSoftDualJwtAuthentication(config)` |
| HMAC request signing + replay | `PubSoft.Security` (+`.Redis` for multi-replica) `AddPubSoftHmacValidation` |
| gateway/entry rate limiting | `PubSoft.AspNetCore` `AddPubSoftGatewayRateLimiting` |
| Redis cache / distributed lock | `PubSoft.Caching.Redis` |
| outbound token acquisition (client-credentials) | `PubSoft.Tokens` `AddPubSoftTokens` |
| local machine-token issuance | `PubSoft.Tokens` `MachineTokenProvider` |
| reliable event delivery | `PubSoft.Messaging.Outbox` (`PublishAsync` + `IOutboxProcessor`) |
| DingTalk/Teams notifications | `PubSoft.Notifications` |
| scheduled HTTP jobs | `PubSoft.Scheduling.Http` |
| module/plugin architecture | `PubSoft.Modularity` |
| health endpoints/diagnostics | `PubSoft.Monitoring`, `PubSoft.AspNetCore` |

## Wiring prerequisites (order matters)

- `AddDbContext<AppDbContext>` with the **concrete** context — base/abstract throws.
- `ICache` before `AddPubSoftTokens` — token provider resolves it at validation.
- Shared `INonceStore` (Redis) for multi-replica replay protection; memory fallback logs a warning.
- `AddPubSoftHealthChecks()` before health endpoints.

## Top pitfalls (ranked by observed frequency)

1. `EfCoreHealthCheck<DbContext>` — base type never resolves → permanent 503 → now fails at registration with the fix message.
2. `services.BuildServiceProvider()` inside registration — nested container resolves different singletons; use `AddOptions<T>().Configure<Provider>(...)`.
3. `http://` on token/JWKS/webhook URLs (non-loopback) — options validation rejects; opt-in per config `AllowInsecure*` only when deliberate.
4. Explicit `TenantId`/`MemberId` outside ambient scope — write guard throws; switch scope (`tenantContext.Change(id)`) or use host scope.
5. Assuming tenant filters after `IgnoreQueryFilters()`/`IgnoreScopeFilters()` — both are privileged; review every call.
6. Rate-limit selectors keyed on attacker-controlled IDs without the cardinality guard — per-IP aggregates exist for exactly this.
7. Missing `AuthServer:Audience` — JWKS scheme accepts tokens minted for other services; startup warning fires; set it unless intentional.

## Compatibility & environment flags (AI-relevant facts)

- **AOT**: pure-managed leaf packages are marked `IsAotCompatible` and verified by
  `tests/PubSoft.AotSmoke` (asserts every marked package is referenced). Packages
  using reflection-JSON are intentionally NOT marked — don't force them into
  AOT-only hosts; add a source-gen `JsonSerializerContext` if you must.
- **Dependency gate**: NU1903/NU1904 are errors — packages with advisories fail
  restore; run restore before claiming a build works.
- **Integration tests**: Redis/MySQL suites skip without env vars
  (`PUBSOFT_REDIS=localhost:7000`, `PUBSOFT_MYSQL=...`) — run them before delivery.
- **Fail-closed defaults**: private-network block, no redirects, bounded
  bodies/queues/caches. Opt-outs are explicit and validated.

## Failure messages teach the fix

Every `ArgumentException`/`OptionsValidationException` in this library names the
correct call shape — read the message, it contains the remedy, not just the error.
